$comment: Contract between Tiled exports and the game. Both the runtime map registry (src/assets/maps.ts) and the build-time validator (scripts/validate-maps.mjs) read this file, so a Tiled export that drifts from it fails the build instead of rendering an empty floor.
$layerOrderComment: Canonical draw order, back to front. Depth comes from layering rather than from bigger images. A map need not use every layer, but any layer it does use must be named from this list — an unlisted name is a typo or a taxonomy drift.
$objectLayerComment: Object layer holding placed world objects. Each object's `type` must name an ObjectDef in src/data/objects — the content validator enforces it.
$pulseLayerComment: Optional per-map `pulseLayer`: an object layer of City Pulse slots. Every slot is a named, uniquely named object with a `type` (wall, corner, shopfront, crowd). Districts list the slots they offer under pulse_slots and the validator checks they exist.
$doorComment: Any spawn-layer object named door_* or typed `door` is a door and must be 32x48 (player height = door height, design system §2). The map validator warns otherwise.
